(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A cooling system installable within a structure wall, comprising: in a housing, the housing disposed between a pair of studs of the wall, a water reservoir; a pump; a pad; a water distributor; a motor; and a fan, wherein the studs are spaced exactly sixteen inches on center.

(Currently Amended) Claim 6: The cooling system of claim 5, wherein the fan causes the cooled air to flow through an opening defined by an outlet incorporated in the housing.

(Currently Amended) Claim 4: The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the pump brings water from the water reservoir to the water distributor and the water distributor distributes the water to the pad thereby moistening the pad, and at least some of the water flows back to the reservoir for recirculation.

(Cancelled) Claim 2: The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the studs are spaced about sixteen inches on center.

(Cancelled) Claim 3: The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the studs are spaced about twenty-four inches on center.

(Currently Amended) Claim 17: A cooling system, comprising: a mounting configuration structured for installation within a structure wall, an evaporative cooling system structured to cool an indoor area. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 18: The cooling system of claim 17, wherein the mounting configuration includes placing the evaporative cooling system between wall studs spaced precisely sixteen inches on center.
